implemented_requirements.requirement: Dice rolling and player movement around the board
implemented_requirements.evidence: dice.py defines a Dice class with roll(). Game.normal_turn and Game.move_player use it to move players, handling passing GO salary.
board.py defines Property with owner attribute. Game.offer_property_purchase prompts the player, deducts money, assigns owner and adds to Player.properties (player.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rent collection when landing on owned properties
implemented_requirements.evidence: Property.land_on calls Game.charge_rent which logs and transfers rent from the landing player to the owner.
chance.py defines ChanceCard with effects (money, move_to, jail, etc.) and a deck. Game.draw_chance draws a card, logs it, and applies its effect.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Tracking player money and net worth
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py stores money, provides receive/pay, and net_worth (cash + property purchase prices). Game logs money changes.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display of game state and prompting for decisions
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.display_status prints round info, each player’s cash, position, properties, jail status, and free‑parking pot; board.display shows the board. UI functions (ui.py) handle yes/no and choice prompts.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail mechanics (visiting, sending, getting out, fines, Get‑Out‑of‑Jail cards)
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py defines JailSpace and GoToJailSpace. Game.send_to_jail, Game.handle_jail_turn, and related logic implement three‑turn attempts, paying fine, using free cards, and rolling doubles.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Free Parking pot that collects taxes/fines and can be collected
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.pay_to_pot adds money to free_parking_pot; TaxSpace and jail fine use it. FreeParkingSpace.land_on calls Game.collect_free_parking.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Simplified board with properties, taxes, chance, jail, free parking, and Go
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.build_board creates a list of Space subclasses covering all required types.
Game.handle_bankruptcy ends the game when one player remains; Game.declare_winner announces the richest player after max rounds.

critical_issues: Landing exactly on GO does not award the $200 salary (only awarded when passing GO).
Negative "money" chance effects and jail fines are sent to the Free Parking pot via Game.pay_to_pot, which deviates from standard Monopoly rules.
In ChanceCard.apply for "collect_each" and "pay_each" the bankruptcy check references the wrong player variable, though active_players already filters bankrupt players.
judge.summary: The submitted code implements a functional, simplified Monopoly‑style game covering dice rolls, board navigation, property purchase, rent, chance cards, money tracking, jail rules, and a free‑parking pot. Core gameplay loops, user prompts, and end‑game logic are present, making the program likely executable. Minor rule deviations (GO salary on exact landing, handling of fines) are noted but do not prevent the core requirements from being met.
